about.description: QQQX is an ETF perpetual listed on Delta Exchange India, tracking Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1, margined and cash-settled in USD. Traders get synthetic price exposure only — no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Funding settles every 8h. Up to 25× leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
